description: Research data for "Distribution-system planning of small modular reactors, renewable generation and battery storage for data-centre resilience is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jose L. Bernal-Agustin, Juan M. Lujano-Rojas (Universidad de Zaragoza). The deposit contains processed inputs, final deterministic optimisation outputs, sensitivity campaigns, numerical-validation evidence and figure-level data used in the article "Distribution-system planning of small modular reactors, renewable generation and battery storage for data-centre resilience". It excludes development archives, checkpoints, superseded pre-R1 results and the multi-gigabyte MATLAB workspaces created during optimisation. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
